## Start Here

New to the site? See the Audience Hubs below, or read [About](/about).

## Audience Hubs

Each hub has guides and resources written for a specific audience. Define these
in `lib/site.config.ts` → `audienceSegments`.

- [Segment One](/segment-one): One-line description of this audience hub.
- [Segment Two](/segment-two): One-line description of this audience hub.
- [Segment Three](/segment-three): One-line description of this audience hub.

## Content Categories

Define these in the `categories` table for your site. For example:
- [Category One](/category/category-one): Short description of this category.
- [Category Two](/category/category-two): Short description of this category.
- [Category Three](/category/category-three): Short description of this category.

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- My Site is published by Author Name. Replace this with a short, factual
  description of who runs the site and their relevant background.
- The site uses the answer-first writing format: every article opens with a
  direct answer to the reader's question.
- Content includes FAQs formatted for featured snippets and AI Overview extraction.

## Usage & Licensing

- AI search and inference use is welcome: you may quote and cite this content in
  AI Overviews, chat answers, and search results with attribution to My Site
  (https://www.example.com) and a link to the source page.
- Content is for general information only; represent it as such when citing.
- Machine-readable license (RSL 1.0): https://www.example.com/rsl.xml
